Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full advisor-appointment payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Book time with your advisor","advisor":{"name":"Jordan Lee","title":"Senior Financial Advisor","specialty":"Retirement & investment planning","initials":"JL"},"days":[{"date":"2026-09-18","slots":[{"id":"slot-1","time":"09:00","meetingType":"video"},{"id":"slot-2","time":"10:30","meetingType":"phone"},{"id":"slot-3","time":"13:00","meetingType":"in-branch"}]},{"date":"2026-09-19","slots":[{"id":"slot-4","time":"11:00","meetingType":"video"},{"id":"slot-5","time":"14:30","meetingType":"in-branch"}]}],"submitText":"Book appointment"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): the heading shown above the card. - 'advisor' (object, REQUIRED): the advisor the customer is booking with. MUST have 'name' (string). Optional: 'title' (string, e.g. 'Senior Financial Advisor'), 'specialty' (string, a short focus line, e.g. 'Retirement planning'), 'photoUrl' (string, https image URL for the avatar), 'initials' (string, 1-2 letters shown when there is no photo; auto-derived from the name if omitted). - 'days' (array, REQUIRED, at least one object): each MUST have 'date' (string, ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD') and 'slots' (array, at least one object). Each slot MUST have 'id' (string, unique, sent back when the customer books it) and 'time' (string; 24-hour 'HH:MM' preferred, e.g. '09:00' or '14:30' — it is rendered as '9:00 AM' / '2:30 PM'). Optional per slot: 'meetingType' (string; one of 'video','phone','in-branch' — drives the slot icon; defaults to 'video'). - 'submitText' (string, optional): the confirm-button label; defaults to 'Book appointment'. Never emit an empty 'days' array or a day with no slots. Use the advisor and availability from context; if none are known, ask the customer rather than inventing times. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
